name: batman-telltale-ukrainian
description: Ukrainian localization of Batman: The Telltale Series - shortcuts for the translation scripts

scripts.import: python .claude/skills/telltale-batman-localization/scripts/apply_translations.py data/game_text/original_data speaker_genders.xlsx translation_table.xlsx data/game_text/localized_data --unique data/game_text/unique_original_data data/game_text/unique_localized_data --credits data/game_text/credits && npm run choice-stats && npm run about-button && npm run feed-item && npm run feed-texture -- --if-available
scripts.check: python .claude/skills/telltale-batman-localization/scripts/check_consistency.py data/game_text/original_data speaker_genders.xlsx data/game_text/unique_localized_data data/game_text/localized_data --credits data/game_text/credits
scripts.rebuild: python .claude/skills/telltale-batman-localization/scripts/build_tm.py data/game_text/original_data speaker_genders.xlsx translation_table.xlsx --order ai_context/play_order.txt --official ai_context/official_usage.txt
scripts.unique-original: python .claude/skills/telltale-batman-localization/scripts/build_tm.py data/game_text/original_data speaker_genders.xlsx translation_table.xlsx --order ai_context/play_order.txt --official ai_context/official_usage.txt --unique-original data/game_text/unique_original_data
